Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] Vanilla hard mode
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► The vanilla experience, but much harder ◄
A much harder version of the vanilla game.
◆ Changes ◆ • Difficulty: Choose Standard, Nightmare or Hell. • Monster stats refitted to a level curve, draw lists capped to the story progression, new EXP/AP. • Fixed encounter levels per story zone. • Rebalanced character growth, junctions, weapons, GFs, enemy attacks and starting setup. • Only the monster stats change: models, animations and textures stay vanilla or come from your other mods.
Needs FFNx 1.25.0 or later.
◆ Cronos team ◆ • Hobbitdur: The code master. • Nihil: The one who actually gets things done. • DangerousDom: The mad tester. • Malekith: The mathematician.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 0.1 Initial release. • 0.2 Add Standard, Nightmare and Hell difficulty options. • 0.3 Improve compatibility with other mods. Fix some left over texture/AI change.
